description: MCP server connecting your Zotero library to Claude and other AI assistants (search, cite, summarize, semantic search). Installs the PyPI package 'zotero-mcp-server' (54yyyu); the command is 'zotero-mcp'.
notes: zotero-mcp is an MCP server: your AI tool launches it on demand over stdio, so you do NOT run it standalone or set it to auto-start.

Connect to Zotero (local API, read-only, no key): in Zotero 7 enable Settings > Advanced > 'Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero', keep Zotero running, and pass ZOTERO_LOCAL=true. For web/write access use ZOTERO_API_KEY + ZOTERO_LIBRARY_ID instead.
Register it in your AI tool's MCP config:
Claude Code:    claude mcp add zotero --env ZOTERO_LOCAL=true -- zotero-mcp
Claude Desktop: run 'zotero-mcp setup' (guides local/web setup and writes the Desktop config)
Semantic search is included (the 'semantic' extra / chromadb); first use downloads an embedding model (~80MB) into the cache.
